title: Handle Kinds And Link Compatibility
description: Add handle semantic handleKind per handle and central ordered compatibility pairs (fromKind,toKind). Empty list = no restriction. WASM host filters link snap and commit for incompatible pairs. Wire through BoardCanvas and descriptor JSON.
summary: Added optional handleKind on handles (descriptor JSON handleKind, fixture handleKind/handle_kind) and host-level ordered compatibility pairs handle_link_compat_pairs. Empty pair list preserves prior unrestricted linking; non-empty list gates nearest_link_snap_handle_world and try_commit_link_edge. Exposed WASM setHandleLinkCompatJson, BoardRenderer.setHandleLinkCompatibility, and BoardCanvas handleLinkCompatibility prop. Rust host tests cover reject vs accept; Vitest covers declarative handleKind sync.
